title: 2027 Western States 100 Participant Guide
claims: Because almost half of the trail may be traveled at night, each runner should carry two LED flashlights; if lights fail, wait for another runner with a light or for the search and rescue sweep teams.
Western States is a cupless race; runners carry their own reusable cup, and warm clothing plus an extra flashlight are recommended in drop bags for the night sections.
Temperatures can range from near zero to above 110 °F along the course; runners should plan layered clothing and keep warm layers accessible through crew or drop bags.
Pacers may not carry water, food, flashlights, shoes or clothing for their runner; supplies are individual, and no muling is allowed on the course.
